name: hud_ui_show_message_box
description: HudUi::ShowMessageBox constructs a stack HudUiMessageBoxDialog from dialog.zrd/MESSAGEBOX, runs it modally with the caller strings/context and -1.0 timeout, destroys it, and returns the modal result.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x438350 yet; current evidence is functional only.

The native smoke coverage verifies the composed constructor, modal loop, and destructor behavior rather than invoking ShowMessageBox directly, because the retail wrapper hardcodes dialog.zrd/MESSAGEBOX and the modal loop is resource/input driven.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x438350 validates the stack HudUiMessageBoxDialog allocation, Constructor("dialog.zrd", "MESSAGEBOX"), RunModal(messageText, titleText, modalContext, -1.0f), Destructor, and return of the modal result.
The source implementation is a direct wrapper over the same accepted constructor, RunModal, and destructor callees with the widened RunModal ABI.
The native message-box smokes verify constructor fallback object state, the modal loop/return behavior, and destructor teardown for the same composed callee set.
